events.name: Buffalo Bills at New York Jets

headlines.description: Buffalo's defense shut down Rex Ryan's former team for much of Thursday night, and the Bills scored on offense and special teams in a 22-17 victory over the New York Jets.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills hold off Jets in Rex's return to Meadowlands

events.name: Detroit Lions at Green Bay Packers

headlines.description: Matthew Stafford threw for two touchdowns, and the Lions stopped a 24-game road losing streak against the Packers when they held on for an 18-16 victory Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions stop road skid against Packers with 18-16 win

headlines.description: Cam Newton completed his first 11 passes -- the longest streak of his career -- and undefeated Carolina shut out Tennessee in the second half of a 27-10 victory on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Newton's hot start helps unbeaten Panthers top Titans 27-10

events.name: Chicago Bears at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Zach Miller caught two touchdown passes, including an 87-yard score that was Chicago's longest play since 2010, leading the Bears to a 37-13 victory over the Rams on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Long plays by Miller, Langford help Bears past Rams 37-13

headlines.description: Chris McCain knocked Sam Bradford out and Reshad Jones spoiled Mark Sanchez's comeback bid.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dolphins knock out Bradford, rally past Eagles

headlines.description: Ben Roethlisberger came off the bench to throw for 379 yards and three touchdowns as the Pittsburgh Steelers overwhelmed the hapless Browns and Johnny Manziel 30-9 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Big Ben solid in relief as Steelers rout Browns

events.name: Dallas Cowboys at Tampa Bay Buccaneers

headlines.description: Jameis Winston scored on a 1-yard quarterback keeper with 54 seconds remaining Sunday, giving the Tampa Bay Buccaneers a 10-6 victory that extended the Dallas Cowboys' longest losing streak since
headlines.shortLinkText: Winston's 1-yard TD run lifts Bucs  over Cowboys 10-6

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Washington Redskins

headlines.description: Kirk Cousins threw for a career-high four touchdowns -- each one longer than any scoring pass he had completed all season -- to lead the Redskins past the Saints 47-14 on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cousins throws career-high 4 TDs, Redskins rout Saints 47-14

headlines.description: Jason Myers kicked a 53-yard field goal after Jacksonville got one final play on a facemask penalty with no time left, and the Jaguars ended their 13-game road losing streak with a 22-20 win.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jaguars top Ravens 22-20 on 53-yard FG to end road skid

headlines.description: Adrian Peterson ran for 203 yards and a touchdown in his record-tying sixth career 200-yard game, and the Vikings took sole possession of first place in the NFC North with a win over the Raiders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Peterson helps Vikings run past Raiders 30-14

events.name: Kansas City Chiefs at Denver Broncos

headlines.description: The Kansas City Chiefs prevented Peyton Manning from getting the one record he really wanted, trouncing the Denver Broncos 29-13 Sunday on the strength of five interceptions and five field goals.

events.name: New England Patriots at New York Giants

headlines.description: Stephen Gostkowski snuck in a 54-yard field goal with one second left Sunday to give the Patriots a comeback, 27-26 win over the Giants to stay perfect and move to 9-0.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots edge Giants with late FG to stay perfect

headlines.description: Carson Palmer had 363 yards and three touchdowns, Andre Ellington had a 48-yard touchdown run with 1:58 remaining, and the Cardinals upped their NFC West lead over the Seahawks to three games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cards fend off Seahawks rally to extend West lead

headlines.description: T.J. Yates took over Monday after Brian Hoyer sustained a concussion and rallied the Houston Texans to a 10-6 victory over Cincinnati, the Bengals' first loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: Texans hand Bengals first loss as Yates steps up
